steps.note: Create the RFQ event needed for the vendor bidding scenario.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the line item whose RFQ value will be used for the later comparison.
Commit a bidding schedule so the RFQ can be published.
Invite a vendor to provide the RFQ value.
Publish the RFQ for vendor bidding.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor session.
Open the RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor’s reference RFQ bid was accepted.
Return to the buyer console to close the bidding window.
Close the RFQ so the later CBD phase can be reached.
Return to the vendor session for the CBD workflow.
Reopen the event’s vendor-side pricing view.
